name: ClarifyAsk
description:
A free-text clarification: the agent's question, its best guesses as one-tap answers, and
a field for anything else. Enter sends; Shift+Enter adds a line.

props.name: ask
props.type: { type: "clarify"; placeholder?: string; suggestions?: string[]; } & { id: string; question: string; detail?: string; status?: import("../types.js").AskState; answer?: string; answeredBy?: string; answeredByEntity?: import("../types.js").EntityRef; answeredAt?: number; submitLabel?: string; }
props.description: The clarification ask: the question, optional `suggestions` as one-tap answers and the free-text `placeholder`. Answers go to the `answer` conversation handler; once answered, expired or cancelled the card shows its record.
